scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.build:server: cd server && dotnet restore && dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore --verbosity quiet -p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=true
scripts.test: pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:server
scripts.precommit: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint:md
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd client && pnpm install && cd ../server && dotnet restore
